stories.title: Fed and Bessent fight for credibility as 10-year Treasury yield tops 5%
stories.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose above 5%, putting pressure on the Federal Reserve and Treasury Secretary Bessent to defend their credibility, according to Yahoo Finance. The report frames this as a test of confidence in US fiscal and monetary policy.
